recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆小至中型淋巴球，核圓、染色質塊狀，外圍有一圈偏藍的細胞質；但核仍大致位於中央、看不到明顯核周淡染區（hof），漿細胞樣特徵並不典型。
features: Single small-to-medium lymphocyte with high-moderate N:C ratio
Round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin, no visible nucleolus
Narrow rim of basophilic (blue) cytoplasm surrounding the nucleus
Nucleus essentially central; no distinct eccentric placement or perinuclear hof
Background red cells largely normocytic with a few small dot-like inclusions or overlying platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small-to-medium lymphocyte with a round nucleus, clumped chromatin and a rim of moderately basophilic cytoplasm. The nucleus is nearly central and a perinuclear hof is not appreciated, so plasmacytoid features (eccentric nucleus, abundant deep-blue cytoplasm) are only subtle in this cell. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable apart from occasional small dot-like inclusions. Findings are compatible with a reactive lymphocyte with mild plasmacytoid differentiation; a single cell cannot establish a clonal process.

ddx.vs: A plasma cell has an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin, abundant deep-blue cytoplasm and a prominent perinuclear hof, more developed than in this cell.
Morphology overlaps; clonality requires a monotypic population on flow cytometry and MYD88 L265P testing rather than single-cell appearance.
A resting lymphocyte has only a scant, barely visible cytoplasmic rim, whereas this cell has a more obvious basophilic rim.
